items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: "he came up to me and said, 'Listen, Roy... I'll give them to you, but as a friend. I know you cats are great. So as a friend, let me rehearse your band on the tangos.'"

ctx.x: It was Sidney, yeah. That's the year we went in. So we got it straight... No, Paul Martell was the other band. All these people that was doing the tango, they was giving me hell, you know. And actually, what really sold me on the gig after he got with me, he came up to me and said, "Listen, Roy. I have a lot of orchestrations of tangos and Viennese waltzes [and I didn't have none of that!] and the rhumbas and things like this, things for (?), and I'll give them to you, but as a friend. I know you cats are great.…
